0022600087.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Charlotte Hornets visit the Brooklyn Nets, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Charlotte a 60% chance to win. The Hornets won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 117-86 win in Brooklyn on March 31, 2026. Six Hornets are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions: Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Grayson Allen (knee soreness), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), Kylan Boswell (knee), and Moussa Diabate (elbow), while Brooklyn is without Joshua Jefferson (back).
